Question:
Provide the full names of drivers who have been overtaken on track more times than they have overtaken others on track during race laps, excluding position changes due to pit stops (both at pit entry and exit), retirements, or position changes that occurred during the first lap of a race (considered as start movements).

4 candidates were produced independently. Each shows its SQL and the first rows of its result.

[A]
SQL:
WITH pit_stop_laps AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT race_id, lap FROM pit_stops
),
retirement_laps AS (
    SELECT race_id, TRY_CAST(lap AS BIGINT) as lap FROM retirements
),
position_changes AS (
    SELECT 
        race_id,
        driver_id,
        lap,
        position,
        LAG(position) OVER (PARTITION BY race_id, driver_id ORDER BY lap) as prev_position
    FROM lap_positions
    WHERE lap > 0
)
SELECT 
    d_ext.full_name,
    d_ext.driver_id,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pc.position < pc.prev_position) as overtakes,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pc.position > pc.prev_position) as overtaken
FROM position_changes pc
JOIN drivers_ext d_ext ON pc.driver_id = d_ext.driver_id
WHERE pc.position != pc.prev_position
  AND pc.lap > 1
  AND pc.lap NOT IN (SELECT lap FROM pit_stop_laps WHERE race_id = pc.race_id)
  AND pc.lap NOT IN (SELECT lap FROM retirement_laps WHERE race_id = pc.race_id)
GROUP BY pc.driver_id, d_ext.full_name, d_ext.driver_id
HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pc.position > pc.prev_position) > COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pc.position < pc.prev_position)
ORDER BY overtaken DESC

    race_id,
    driver_id,
    lap,
    position,
    LAG(position) OVER (PARTITION BY race_id, driver_id ORDER BY lap) AS prev_position,
    position - LAG(position) OVER (PARTITION BY race_id, driver_id ORDER BY lap) AS position_change
  FROM race_laps
),
overtake_events AS (
  SELECT 
    race_id,
    driver_id,
    lap AS lap_at_change,
    prev_position,
    position AS position_after,
    CASE 
      WHEN prev_position > position THEN -1  -- overtaken (position decreased)
      WHEN prev_position < position THEN 1   -- overtook (position increased)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS direction
  FROM position_changes
  WHERE position_change IS NOT NULL AND position_change != 0
)
SELECT race_id, driver_id, lap_at_change, prev_position, position_after, direction
FROM overtake_events
WHERE lap_at_change != 1
  AND (driver_id, lap_at_change) NOT IN (SELECT race_id, driver_id FROM driver_retired)
ORDER BY race_id, driver_id, lap_at_change
